description: This file contains JavaScript code related to the TestLink open source project, specifically for automation and interacting with web pages via AJAX. It includes functions for opening import result windows, starting test case execution via AJAX calls, creating XMLHttpRequest objects, and handling state changes during asynchronous operations.

methods.name: openImportResult(windows_title,tproject_id,tplan_id,build_id,platform_id)
methods.description: Opens a new window for XML import results, passing in test project, plan, build, and platform IDs as URL parameters.

methods.name: startExecution(node_id,node_type)
methods.description: Initiates the execution of a test case via an AJAX GET request to the server.

methods.name: GetXmlHttpObject()
methods.description: Creates and returns an XMLHttpRequest object, supporting various browsers.

methods.name: stateChanged()
methods.description: Handles the AJAX state change, updating the DOM with execution progress or results.
